commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: Poverty, which increases sorrow, won’t come to those whose sweet words increase everyone’s joy. Poverty is the senses lacking what they would enjoy. Such people have no enemies and no strangers, only friends, and so gain all wealth.
